name: @redhat-cloud-services/hcc-pf-mcp

tools.name: getPatternFlyDataViewDescription
tools.description: Get a description of the @patternfly/react-data-view package and its capabilities for building advanced data tables with PatternFly.

tools.name: getPatternFlyDataViewExample
tools.description: Get an implementation example of the @patternfly/react-data-view package in a React application. Choose from multiple scenarios including basic usage, advanced features like sorting, filtering, pagination, and selection, and integration with other PatternFly components.

exampleName.description: The name of the @patternfly/react-data-view implementation example to retrieve. Available examples: minimalSetup, commonUsage, toolbarExample, filters, table, resizeableColumns, treeTable, loadingState, tableStates.

tools.name: getAvailableModules
tools.description: Retrieves a list of available Patternfly react-core modules in the current environment.

packageName.description: Name of the patternfly package to get modules for. For tables its always better to use the @patternfly/react-data-view package.

nodeModulesRootPath.description: Optional absolute path to the node_modules directory root. If not provided, will use the current working directory.

tools.name: getComponentSourceCode
tools.description: Retrieve a source code of a specified Patternfly react-core module in the current environment.

packageName.description: Name of the patternfly package to get component from. For tables its always better to use the @patternfly/react-data-view package.

nodeModulesRootPath.description: Optional absolute path to the node_modules directory root. If not provided, will use the current working directory.

tools.name: getReactUtilityClasses
tools.description: Retrieves a list of available Patternfly react-styles utility classes in the current environment.

utilityName.description: Name of a set of utility classes to retrieve from @patternfly/react-styles.

nodeModulesRootPath.description: Optional absolute path to the node_modules directory root. If not provided, will use the current working directory.

instructions: You are a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for all PatternFly packages and components. You provide comprehensive assistance with PatternFly development, including component documentation, implementation examples, source code access, module discovery, and CSS utility integration. You support all PatternFly packages: react-core, react-icons, react-table, react-data-view, react-component-groups, and react-styles.
